# [STORY] As a platform operator, I want the gateway's runtime security-management API restricted to administrators, so that changing the live security posture is an administrator-only action

## User Story
**As a** platform operator
**I want** the gateway's runtime security-management API restricted to administrators
**So that** changing the gateway's live security posture is an administrator-only action, not something any signed-in account can do

## Parent Epic
Parent: #76

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [ ] Given a caller whose token carries the ADMIN role, when it calls an `/admin/**` gateway endpoint, then the request is served
- [ ] Given an authenticated caller without the ADMIN role, when it calls an `/admin/**` gateway endpoint, then the gateway refuses it with 403
- [ ] Given an anonymous caller, when it calls an `/admin/**` gateway endpoint, then the gateway refuses it with 401
- [ ] Given the gateway test suite runs, when the `/admin/**` rules are exercised, then all three outcomes above are asserted through the real security filter chain, not a mocked one
